venueFixes.note: Schedule rows name the home team's usual stadium; venue from the nflverse play-by-play stadium field. Madrid roof closed per the NFL gamebook.

openRoof.note: nflverse codes no 2024 or 2025 game as roof open (10 to 11 a season in 2021 to 2023), so open-roof games at retractable stadiums are coded closed and are not in the test.
